title: REQ · Item icon PNGs are generated and registered in the manifest at declared size
summary: Generated item PNGs and manifest entries exist and are covered by the manifest palette and size test
description: Context: art:generate (game/frontend/scripts/generateArt.ts) writes PNGs under game/public/assets and merges entries into worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json; tests/sceneArtSources.test.ts compares generated entries with the committed manifest and checks palette and PNG sizes. Desired behavior: after running art:generate, six item/ entries with 16x16 dimensions are committed with their PNGs, and sceneArtSources.test.ts explicitly asserts them. Why: the criterion asks for icons registered in the manifest and covered by the existing test.
acceptance_criteria: Given the committed manifest, When item/ entries are listed, Then six image entries have dimensions 16x16 and paths ending .png under worlds/the-boys-room/items/.
Given the generated files, When PNG headers are read, Then each item PNG size equals its manifest dimensions.
Given the manifest, When scanned, Then no path ends in .svg.

in_scope: Committed manifest item entries and PNG files

technical_constraints: Manifest is only updated by the deterministic art:generate script, not hand-edited.
definition_of_done: Manifest and PNGs committed in sync with sources.
